import dlt
from pyspark.sql.functions import col, current_timestamp
from pyspark.sql.types import *
from pyspark.sql import SparkSession

spark = SparkSession.getActiveSession()
catalog = spark.conf.get("catalog")
pipeline_schema = spark.conf.get("pipeline_schema")
volume = spark.conf.get("volume")
file_path = f"/Volumes/{catalog}/{pipeline_schema}/{volume}/consumer_order/"

# Explicit schema from metadata_consumer_order.json
schema = StructType([
    StructField("order_id", IntegerType(), nullable=False),
    StructField("consumer_id", IntegerType(), nullable=False),
    StructField("order_date", StringType(), nullable=True),
    StructField("order_status", StringType(), nullable=True),
    StructField("total_amount", DoubleType(), nullable=True),
    StructField("currency", StringType(), nullable=True),
    StructField("payment_method", StringType(), nullable=True),
    StructField("channel", StringType(), nullable=True),
    StructField("billing_address", StringType(), nullable=True),
    StructField("shipping_address", StringType(), nullable=True),
    StructField("operation", StringType(), nullable=False)
])

@dlt.view(name="raw_consumer_order")
def raw_consumer_order():
    df = spark.readStream.format("cloudFiles") \
        .option("cloudFiles.format", "json") \
        .option("multiline", "true") \
        .schema(schema) \
        .load(file_path)
    return df.withColumn("ingestion_time", current_timestamp())

dlt.create_streaming_table("consumer_order_cdc_stream")

dlt.apply_changes(
    target="consumer_order_cdc_stream",
    source=dlt.read("raw_consumer_order"),
    keys=["order_id"],
    sequence_by=col("ingestion_time"),
    apply_as_deletes=col("operation") == "delete",
    except_column_list=["operation", "ingestion_time"],
    stored_as_scd_type=2
)
